title: Saturday 17 October: US banks' losing streak
desc: US bank stocks on their longest weekly losing streak since 2008 despite clean regional results, the AI debt scare spreads from CoreWeave to Asia and Jakarta, and Brent hits 110 dollars ahead of the Fed.

title: Friday 16 October: Nordea pauses buybacks
desc: Nordea pauses buybacks on tougher ECB model rules, the ECB clears UniCredit to take control of Commerzbank, and US Bancorp and PNC report as hot PPI and an AI credit scare hit markets.

title: Thursday 15 October: Nordea pauses buybacks, AI debt hits Asia
desc: Nordea buyback pause on ECB model review and the SEB read-across, Kospi and Nikkei sell-off on AI debt fears, hot US PPI but falling yields, US regional banks, Iambic IPO, and 15 October 2008.
